entries.title: Bandsaw blade drifts off the line
entries.text: With the saw unplugged, check blade tension against the gauge mark, then adjust tracking so the blade runs centred on the upper wheel.

entries.title: Belt sander belt slips
entries.text: Unplug the sander, release the tension lever, re-seat the sanding belt with the arrow pointing in the direction of travel and re-tension.

entries.title: Drill press belt slips or squeals
entries.text: Unplug the drill press, open the pulley cover, loosen the motor lock knob, pull the motor back until the belt deflects about 12 mm, and lock it.

entries.title: Jointer belt squeals on start-up
entries.text: A squeal at start-up means a loose drive belt. Unplug the jointer and ask a trained volunteer to adjust the motor mount.

entries.title: Lathe belt cover will not close
entries.text: Unplug the lathe. Move the belt fully onto a matching pair of pulley steps before closing the cover. Never run the lathe with the cover open.

entries.title: Planer belt shows wear
entries.text: Cracks or glazing on the planer belt mean it must be replaced. Tag the planer out of service and report it.

entries.title: Table saw belt tension
entries.text: Belt tension on the table saw is adjusted only by the supervisor. Tag the saw out of service.

entries.title: Smoke or burning smell from a saw
entries.text: Stop the machine, unplug it if safe, keep people away and tell the supervisor at once. Do not restart the machine.
